meta.title: How I Like My Jeans to Fit so I Don't Look Like a Carrot. (ft. Levi's)
meta.description:
Here are the jeans I mentioned in this video!
1. Levi 501's: https://fave.co/3DFMF9A
3. Naked & Famous Empire State Selvedge

Carrots are good for your eyes but not good for your legs. Trust me.

Ah yes, the perfect fitting pair of men's jeans. Did I decide to make a fit guide? No. Well idk. Or women's jeans, idc. There are the classic light tapered (or straight depending on the year) Levi 501's that are usually considered "the perfect jean". BUT we also have, straight, slim straight, tapered, athletic taper, blah blah blah. How do I like to fit my jeans? What is this about a leg opening? The RATIO?! What could it be! Stay tuned and find on out!

*Note* a few jeans I show in this video are raw (the selvedge ones) those are a little stiffer than regular jeans so they drape a bit differently.
